blocks.text: A briefing for the leadership of {{fact:f:E-2021-001.client}}, prepared by Verdant Health Advisory. The review commenced on {{fact:f:E-2021-001.start}} and runs for about three months, and this is an early look at where it stands and where it goes from here.
What we are here to answer

items: Whether the compensation arrangements for your physicians sit within the range a fair-market-value analysis would support.
Whether those arrangements are commercially reasonable on their own terms, apart from the volume or value of any referrals.
Where the written plans and the arrangements as they actually operate have drifted apart from one another.
What all of that means for the compliance footing your counsel has to stand on when the question is asked.
We are in the early phase, assembling and sourcing the physician compensation data before any of it is interpreted.
The benchmark sources are being scoped, so the comparison is settled before it is ever used against an arrangement.
Some executed agreements arrived as scanned images with no text layer, so those figures are being keyed and checked by hand.
No conclusions yet, and that is by design; the arrangements have not all been placed against their benchmarks.

blocks.text: How we are going about it

items: We collect the arrangements as they actually work, not only as the plan documents describe them.
We place each against published national survey benchmarks matched to specialty, productivity, and market.
We keep what is confirmed cleanly apart from what is still open, so that nothing travels before it is sourced.
We lead with the finding and label a recommendation as a recommendation, never as a fact.
Patricia Moore, Analyst -- compensation data and sourcing.
Daniel Alvarado, Senior Consultant -- benchmark selection and service-line economics.
Laura Phillips, Chief Financial Officer, Johnson, Cross and Gibbs -- your sponsor and our point of sign-off.
We complete the sourced inventory of the arrangements under review.
We settle the benchmark set with your team before any comparison is drawn.
We bring you a first read only once the data behind it can be shown, and not a step before.
